Name: CP - SDS Hovsep Seasonal Outfits
Author: famiichikii
Description:
Our beloved octopus is sensitive to the weather, and don't you ever want to just give him a warm sweater in winter, or strip off his black turtleneck in the summer? With this mod, you can give him outfits appropriate for the season, yay! <3
If you install this mod after marriage, isn't it similar to taking care of him now that he is loved? I always wanted to do that anyway TT

我们深爱的章鱼对天气非常敏感。你有没有想过，在冬天给他穿上一件暖和的毛衣，或者在夏天帮他脱掉那件黑色高领衫呢？有了这个模组，你就可以让他根据季节换上合适的衣服啦，耶！<3
如果你是在结婚后才安装这个模组，那就好像是在照顾已经被爱着的他，对吧？我一直都很想这样做 TT

The mod comes in two standalone parts:
模组内容分为两个独立部分：

[b]人物行走图（Sprites）：[/b]
An outfit each for Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter (currently no beach or festival). Hovsep will now take off his coat and hat indoors, so it doesn't feel strange cuddling a man in a rain jacket at night ;;
为春、夏、秋、冬各准备了一套服装（目前还没有海滩或节日装）。现在 [size=3]霍夫塞普[/size] 会在室内脱下外套和帽子，这样晚上就不会感觉像在和一个穿着雨衣的男人拥抱了;;

[img]https://cdn.imgchest.com/files/3f0d82134d21.gif[/img]
Install via the "[CP] SDS Hovsep Seasonal Outfits" file.﻿
通过安装 "[CP] SDS Hovsep Seasonal Outfits" 文件启用。

[b]立绘（Portraits）：[/b]
The portraits can match the new sprites too!
立绘也可以与新行走图相匹配！

[img]https://cdn.imgchest.com/files/e53733ac96ed.png[/img]﻿
Install via the "[PP] SDS Hovsep Seasonal Portraits" file located in "Optional Files" section, and requires Portraiture & Portraiture Plus.
[b][i]!!! If the portrait doesn't show, this is normal. Try pressing "p" key while talking to Hou to fix the portrait.

通过安装位于“Optional Files（可选文件）”部分的 [b]"[PP] SDS Hovsep Seasonal Portraits"[/b] 文件启用，需要依赖 [b]Portraiture[/b] 和 [b]Portraiture Plus[/b]。
!!! 如果立绘没有显示，这是正常现象。与 Hovsep 对话时尝试按下 “P” 键即可修复。[/i][/b]

[b]Big Notice!!![/b]
The character, sprites and portraits are edits of the original art by the Ricehit team and belong to them. I went and got permission from them to share this mod!
The fall outfit is designed after official art of Hovsep from the concept art available on their Kofi. 

I tried my best to match the original style, but I'm not a pro, so apologies if it's ugly T-T

⚠️重要说明！！！角色、行走图和立绘均为 [b]Ricehit 团队[/b] 原作的修改版本，版权归原作者所有。
我已获得他们的授权，才发布了这个模组！
秋季服装的设计参考了他们在 Kofi 上公开的 [size=3]霍夫塞普[/size] 官方概念图。
我已经尽力模仿原作风格了，但我不是专业画师，如果看起来有点丑，请多包涵 T-T

<3
